answers.reason: By introduces a deadline.
Efficiently is the adverb modifying work.
Despite takes the noun phrase the heavy rain.
Each applicant is a singular subject; is required is the passive form.
Carefully is the adverb modifying review.
Who is the subject of installed and refers to the technician.
Since introduces the starting point 2021 with the present perfect.
Once introduces the clause describing when the email will be sent.
The structure is adjective + enough + to-infinitive.
Lower is the comparative required before than.
The adjective unavailable follows will be.
By Friday at 5:00 p.m. states the borrowing deadline.
The sentence reassures current borrowers about the software update; the other statements contradict or do not fit the notice.
The noun patience is the object of appreciate after your.
The email explicitly says the projector in Room A is being repaired.
The email requests a laptop and the attached stock report.
Participants wanting lunch should reply by Monday, June 10.
Opening at 6:00 a.m. one hour earlier means the previous opening time was 7:00 a.m.
The pool closes from July 3 to July 5 for cleaning.
The notice says to bring a membership card to enter the other branch.
